notes.title: SubliminalRegion Ver1.1
notes.content:
This is AxiaBridge.

Subliminal Region Ver1.1 has been released.
The corrections this time are as follows.

-Corrected the following typographical errors in Chapter 4, Episode 2.
[Lukyanov] "Does Lieutenant Izumi have any idea about that?"
↓
[Lukyanov] "Does Captain Izumi have any idea about that?"

Thank you.
